findings.actual: Returns 200 and purges cache paths despite the five-minute freshness contract
findings.environment: Local isolated lane05 database and mock CMS; configured signed revalidation sender
findings.expected: Reject with 401 because freshness cannot be established; perform no purge
findings.fix: Convert once, require a finite numeric timestamp, then enforce the five-minute age window before parsing or mutation
findings.preconditions: Valid webhook signature over a non-finite timestamp value
findings.regression: Non-finite timestamp cases not-a-timestamp, NaN and Infinity assert 401 and zero revalidation calls
findings.reproduction: Send a correctly signed revalidation request whose timestamp parses to NaN
findings.residual_risk: Freshness still depends on sender and receiver clock agreement within the documented five-minute window
findings.root_cause: Number(timestamp) produces NaN and the age comparison is false, so the invalid timestamp falls through
findings.title: Invalid signed webhook timestamp bypasses freshness validation
findings.validation: Four focused suites 24 of 24 passed; HTTP contract journey 9 of 9 passed including NaN 401 and valid signed publication 200; CMS typecheck, focused ESLint and diff checks passed

findings.actual: Variants throw, acknowledge invalid input, or purge a path before failing
findings.affected: Revalidation webhook request parsing and mutation ordering
findings.environment: Local isolated lane05 database and mock CMS; configured signed revalidation sender
findings.fix: Validate the parsed value is a non-array object, require a positive safe integer article ID, and require supported fields to be strings before invalidating any path
findings.preconditions: Validly signed request with null, scalar, array or structurally invalid JSON body
findings.regression: Null, array, numeric slug and object article ID bodies assert 400 and zero revalidation calls before a valid signed control
findings.reproduction: Submit signed malformed body variants and observe response plus purge calls
findings.residual_risk: The endpoint intentionally ignores authenticated event names outside the publication transition contract
findings.root_cause: The route uses parsed JSON fields without first validating that the body is an object with supported scalar values
findings.title: Malformed webhook bodies bypass the request boundary
findings.validation: Four focused suites 24 of 24 passed; HTTP contract journey 9 of 9 passed; CMS typecheck, focused ESLint and diff checks passed; webhook fixture restored disabled and null settings
